tour.title: Start at the browser entry
tour.description: index.html restores the saved theme before src/main.jsx mounts App. App owns four hash routes; unknown hashes resolve to home.

tour.title: Follow shared navigation and theme
tour.description: Header and Footer consume static route labels. Hash anchors avoid a routing dependency; native details provides the mobile menu.

tour.title: Trace static content into pages
tour.description: content.js provides catalog objects, documentation tuples and ecosystem stages. Home selects featured material; products filter by category. No backend or checkout flow is implemented here.

tour.title: Understand scroll-driven storytelling
tour.description: EcosystemStory schedules scroll updates with requestAnimationFrame; getStoryState clamps progress and chooses a stage. Mobile cards use IntersectionObserver.

tour.title: Inspect native dialogs and team navigation
tour.description: Documentation uses a native image dialog. AboutPage adds team hotspots, profile navigation, close animation and focus restoration; descriptions are placeholders.

tour.title: Separate intended content from shipped routes
tour.description: package.json contains Vite commands and a story assertion script. PAGE_CONTENT.md lists more sections than App currently routes; README contains only the project title.

project.name: jagofarm-website
project.description: JagoFarm React single-page marketing website with hash navigation, product browsing, farm documentation, and scroll-driven ecosystem storytelling.
